headline_marked: Opera launches [[Paste Protect]] to block malicious clipboard content
headline: Opera launches Paste Protect to block malicious clipboard content
summary: Opera's new feature blocks suspicious commands copied from websites
details: Opera has introduced a new feature called Paste Protect, which automatically blocks potentially malicious commands copied from websites to the clipboard. This update aims to enhance user security while browsing the internet.
The feature is designed to prevent harmful content from being pasted into sensitive areas, reducing the risk of security breaches. Paste Protect is now available in the latest Opera update.
Users can benefit from this feature by having an additional layer of protection against malicious activities. This move demonstrates Opera's commitment to user safety and security.
caption:
Can copied text be a security threat? Opera thinks so.

Opera has introduced a new feature called Paste Protect, which automatically blocks potentially malicious commands copied from websites to the clipboard. This update aims to enhance user security while browsing the internet.

The feature is designed to prevent harmful content from being pasted into sensitive areas, reducing the risk of security breaches. Paste Protect is now available in the latest Opera update.

Users can benefit from this feature by having an additional layer of protection against malicious activities. This move demonstrates Opera's commitment to user safety and security.
